challengeTypes: identify: Which of these is an internet service for sending messages? (Email vs Online shopping vs Cloud storage vs LOGO)

sort: Drag each internet service to its correct description (Email = send and receive messages | Search engine = find information online | Online shopping = buy products on the internet | E-learning = study online with courses | Cloud storage = store files on the internet | Video call = talk and see people remotely)
identify: What is an email ATTACHMENT? (A file sent along with an email message vs The email subject line | The email address | The email password)

sort: Drag each email part to its correct description (To = recipient's email address | Subject = short title of the email | Body = main message text | Attachment = file sent with the email | CC = copy to another person | Send = deliver the email)

identify: Which of these is a good internet safety practice? (Use strong passwords with letters, numbers, and symbols vs Share your password with friends | Use your name as your password | Click on every link you receive)

sort: Drag each safety practice to safe or unsafe (Strong password = Safe | Sharing password = Unsafe | Clicking unknown links = Unsafe | Using different passwords = Safe | Sharing personal info online = Unsafe | Logging out after use = Safe | Opening unknown attachments = Unsafe | Privacy settings on social media = Safe)
identify: In LOGO, what does the REPEAT command do? (Runs a set of commands multiple times vs Draws a circle | Deletes commands | Saves the file)

sort: Drag each LOGO command to its correct shape (REPEAT 4 [FD 100 RT 90] = Square | REPEAT 3 [FD 100 RT 120] = Triangle | REPEAT 6 [FD 100 RT 60] = Hexagon | REPEAT 5 [FD 100 RT 72] = Pentagon | REPEAT 8 [FD 100 RT 45] = Octagon | REPEAT 360 [FD 1 RT 1] = Circle)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Internet services — Email: send and receive messages electronically. Search engine: find information online (Google, Bing). Online shopping: buy products on the internet (Amazon, Flipkart). E-learning: study online with courses and tutorials. Cloud storage: store files on the internet (Google Drive, Dropbox). Video calling: talk and see people remotely (Zoom, Google Meet). Social media: connect and share with people. (2) Email — Parts: To (recipient's email address), Subject (short title), Body (main message), Attachment (file sent with email like documents or photos), CC (carbon copy to another person), BCC (blind carbon copy). Composing: open email app, click new message, fill in To, Subject, Body, attach files if needed, click Send. Receiving: check inbox, open message, read or download attachment, reply or forward. (3) Internet safety — Personal information: never share full name, address, phone number, school name, or photos with strangers online. Passwords: use strong passwords with uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols. Never share passwords. Use different passwords for different accounts. Cyber awareness: do not click unknown links, do not open attachments from unknown senders, log out after using public computers, use privacy settings on social media, tell a trusted adult about cyberbullying or suspicious messages. (4) LOGO REPEAT command — REPEAT runs a set of commands multiple times. Syntax: REPEAT n [commands]. Drawing shapes: Square = REPEAT 4 [FD 100 RT 90]. Triangle = REPEAT 3 [FD 100 RT 120]. Pentagon = REPEAT 5 [FD 100 RT 72]. Hexagon = REPEAT 6 [FD 100 RT 60]. Octagon = REPEAT 8 [FD 100 RT 45]. Circle = REPEAT 360 [FD 1 RT 1]. FD = forward, RT = right turn, LT = left turn. The angle for a regular polygon = 360 / number of sides. Misconceptions: 'email and search engines are the same' (WRONG — email is for sending messages; search engines are for finding information), 'attachments are part of the email subject' (WRONG — attachments are FILES sent along with the email, separate from the subject line), 'sharing your password with friends is safe' (WRONG — never share passwords with anyone except trusted parents/guardians), 'REPEAT 4 [FD 100 RT 90] draws a triangle' (WRONG — REPEAT 4 with RT 90 draws a SQUARE; a triangle needs REPEAT 3 with RT 120), 'LOGO can only draw squares' (WRONG — LOGO can draw any shape by changing the REPEAT count and angle: triangles, pentagons, hexagons, circles, stars).
